# pylopdf

> Edit, render, extract, and create PDFs in Python. pylopdf aims to do
> everything pymupdf can do with PDF files through an API of its own, is
> built on the Rust PDF engines lopdf, hayro, and krilla, and is MIT licensed.

Documentation: https://pylopdf.haya.works/
Japanese documentation: https://pylopdf.haya.works/ja/
Simplified Chinese documentation: https://pylopdf.haya.works/zh-cn/
Korean documentation: https://pylopdf.haya.works/ko/
Source: https://github.com/yhay81/pylopdf
PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/pylopdf/

Pages:
- Getting started: https://pylopdf.haya.works/getting-started/
- Migrating from pymupdf: https://pylopdf.haya.works/migration/
- Offline OCR: https://pylopdf.haya.works/ocr/
- Concurrency: https://pylopdf.haya.works/concurrency/
- WebAssembly: https://pylopdf.haya.works/wasm/
- Ecosystem recipes: https://pylopdf.haya.works/ecosystem/
- API reference: https://pylopdf.haya.works/api/
- Security: https://pylopdf.haya.works/security/
- API stability: https://pylopdf.haya.works/stability/
- Benchmarks: https://pylopdf.haya.works/benchmarks/
- Contributing and support: https://pylopdf.haya.works/contributing/

Key facts:
- MIT licensed, no required Python dependencies, Python 3.11 or newer.
- Wheels for Linux, macOS, and Windows, including free-threaded CPython 3.14t
  and 3.15t, plus a WebAssembly wheel for Pyodide 0.28.3 and Cloudflare
  Python Workers.
- Pre-1.0: the next release redesigns the API (ROADMAP.md and
  api/DESIGN.md in the repository); the documentation follows the main
  branch.
- PDF files only. Typesetting, digital signatures, and PDF/A validation are
  done with typst, pyHanko, and veraPDF.
- pylopdf.open(source) opens a path or bytes; pylopdf.Document() is an empty
  document; pylopdf.probe(source) reads page count, version, encryption, and
  metadata without loading the document.
- doc.pages is the page sequence: doc.pages[i], doc.pages[a:b] (a list),
  len(doc.pages), for page in doc.pages, doc.pages.new(size, index=),
  doc.pages.insert(index, pages), doc.pages.extend(pages), del doc.pages[i],
  del doc.pages[a:b], doc.pages.select(indexes), doc.pages.move(index, to),
  doc.pages.labeled(label). A Document itself is not indexable or iterable.
- Page indexes start at 0 everywhere, the outline and page labels included.
- doc.outline is the sequence of top-level OutlineItem handles (title,
  destination, page, children, color, bold, italic, is_open, all assignable
  where it makes sense); doc.outline.walk() visits every item, and assigning
  a list of OutlineEntry(level, title, Destination(page)) records replaces
  the outline. doc.page_labels is a list of PageLabelRange(start, style,
  prefix, first) records, and page.label reads one page's label.
- Coordinates are points with a top-left origin in the displayed page,
  shared by extraction, search, drawing, and rendering. page.boxes (media,
  crop, bleed, trim, art) is the one exception, in PDF user space as stored;
  page.user_to_display maps user space to display space, and page.rotation
  is assigned in multiples of 90.
- Point, Matrix, Rect, IRect, and Quad are immutable NamedTuples with
  pymupdf's operators: p * m, left * right (left transform first), ~m,
  r | p (include), r & o (intersect), r * m (transform), p in r. Replace
  in-place methods such as transform, normalize, or pretranslate with
  assignment of the operator result (r = r.normalized()).
- page.content() returns every text run, path, and image a page paints, in
  paint order, as immutable values with glyph outline boxes, paints, strokes,
  and the clips, transparency groups, and marked content around each item.
- page.pixmap(dpi= or matrix=) renders any invertible matrix; a translation
  moves no pixels and a Pixmap has no origin.
- DocumentLimits.web() and LimitError.code bound untrusted input.

Migrating pymupdf and pylopdf 0.15 code:
- python -m pylopdf.migrate PATH (pip install "pylopdf[migrate]") renames the
  fitz and pymupdf imports, rewrites mechanical replacements such as opening
  documents, the page operations that doc.pages replaced, get_toc/set_toc,
  embfile_*, xref_* readers and in-place geometry methods, and adds a
  "# TODO(pylopdf): <hint>" comment above every statement that still needs a
  person; it then lists those steps as path:line: message.
- Looking up a pymupdf name or a pylopdf 0.15 name that pylopdf lacks raises
  AttributeError whose message names the replacement or the milestone that
  plans it.

pymupdf name map (generated from api/pymupdf-parity.json; each pymupdf name that pylopdf replaced, its
replacement, and the migration hint):
- Annot -> Annotation: page.annotations lists Annotation handles with type, rect, contents, author, subject, created, modified, name, icon, intent, color, interior_color, opacity, flags, xref, and page.
- Annot.__bool__ -> Annotation: An Annotation handle is always true; a handle whose annotation is gone raises StaleObjectError on use.
- Annot.apn_bbox -> Annotation.obj: annotation.obj['AP']['N']['BBox'] is the appearance's bounding box in its own space.
- Annot.apn_matrix -> Annotation.obj: annotation.obj['AP']['N'].get('Matrix') is the appearance's matrix.
- Annot.blendmode -> Annotation.blend_mode: annotation.blend_mode is a BlendMode member, or None without /BM.
- Annot.border -> Annotation.border: annotation.border is a Border(width, style=BorderStyle..., dashes=...) record, or None when the annotation has none.
- Annot.clean_contents -> Annotation.clean_contents: annotation.clean_contents() normalizes every appearance stream of an Annotation handle from page.annotations.
- Annot.colors -> Annotation.color: Read annotation.color and annotation.interior_color, Color records or None.
- Annot.delete_responses -> Annotation.replies: for reply in annotation.replies: del page.annotations[page.annotations.index(reply)] removes the replies with their popups; del annotation.popup_rect removes the popup.
- Annot.file_info -> Annotation.file: annotation.file.filename, .description, .size, .created, and .modified describe the embedded file; annotation.file is None for other annotations.
- Annot.flags -> Annotation.flags: annotation.flags is an AnnotationFlags value.
- Annot.get_file -> AnnotationFile.read: annotation.file.read(max_size=...) returns the embedded file's data.
- Annot.get_oc -> Annotation.layer: Read annotation.layer: a Layer handle, a LayerMembership, or None, instead of an xref.
- Annot.get_parent -> Annotation.page: annotation.page is the Page that holds the annotation.
- Annot.get_pixmap -> Page.pixmap: annotation.page.pixmap(clip=annotation.rect, ...) renders the annotation's area.
- Annot.get_sound -> Annotation.obj: annotation.obj['Sound'] is the sound stream in the object model; read() returns its samples.
- Annot.get_text -> Page.words: [w.text for w in annotation.page.words() if w.bbox.intersects(annotation.rect)] lists the words under the annotation.
- Annot.get_textbox -> Page.words: ' '.join(w.text for w in page.words() if w.bbox in rect) joins the words inside a rectangle.
- Annot.get_textpage -> Page.layout: annotation.page.layout() is the page's structured text; filter its blocks by annotation.rect.
- Annot.has_popup -> Annotation.popup_rect: annotation.popup_rect is not None tells whether the annotation has a popup.
- Annot.info -> Annotation.contents: Read annotation.contents, author, subject, created, modified, name, and icon.
- Annot.irt_xref -> Annotation.in_reply_to: annotation.in_reply_to is the Annotation that this one replies to, or None; its xref is in_reply_to.xref.
- Annot.is_open -> Annotation.is_open: annotation.is_open tells whether the popup, or a note without one, opens when the page is shown.
- Annot.language -> Annotation.language: annotation.language is the /Lang tag, assignable and deletable.
- Annot.line_ends -> Annotation.line_endings: annotation.line_endings is a (start, end) pair of LineEnding members, or None for an annotation other than a line or polyline.
- Annot.next -> Annotations: Iterate page.annotations instead of following annot.next.
- Annot.opacity -> Annotation.opacity: Read annotation.opacity.
- Annot.parent -> Annotation.page: annotation.page is the page that holds the annotation.
- Annot.popup_rect -> Annotation.popup_rect: annotation.popup_rect is the popup's display Rect, or None without a popup.
- Annot.popup_xref -> Annotation.obj: annotation.obj['Popup'] is the popup annotation's dictionary.
- Annot.rect -> Annotation.rect: Read annotation.rect.
- Annot.rect_delta -> Annotation.obj: annotation.obj.get('RD') holds the rectangle differences (left, top, right, bottom).
- Annot.rotation -> Annotation.rotation: annotation.rotation is the clockwise turn of the content as the page is displayed: the page's rotation less /Rotate, which annotation.obj holds.
- Annot.set_apn_bbox -> Annotation.obj: Assign annotation.obj['AP']['N']['BBox'] in the object model; property setters draw the appearance again instead.
- Annot.set_apn_matrix -> Annotation.obj: Assign annotation.obj['AP']['N']['Matrix'] in the object model; property setters draw the appearance again instead.
- Annot.set_blendmode -> Annotation.blend_mode: Assign annotation.blend_mode = BlendMode.MULTIPLY; the appearance is drawn again.
- Annot.set_border -> Annotation.border: Assign annotation.border = Border(width, style=..., dashes=...); the appearance is drawn again.
- Annot.set_colors -> Annotation.color: Assign annotation.color (stroke) and annotation.interior_color (fill) Color values, or None; the appearance is drawn again.
- Annot.set_flags -> Annotation.flags: Assign annotation.flags = AnnotationFlags.PRINT | ...
- Annot.set_info -> Annotation.contents: Assign annotation.contents, author, subject, and name; dates record themselves.
- Annot.set_irt_xref -> Annotation.in_reply_to: Assign annotation.in_reply_to = other_annotation, or None, to set or remove /IRT.
- Annot.set_language -> Annotation.language: Assign annotation.language = 'ja-JP'; del annotation.language removes it.
- Annot.set_line_ends -> Annotation.line_endings: Assign annotation.line_endings = (LineEnding.START, LineEnding.END).
- Annot.set_name -> Annotation.icon: Assign annotation.icon = NoteIcon..., StampIcon..., or AttachmentIcon...
- Annot.set_oc -> Annotation.layer: Assign a Layer or LayerMembership to annotation.layer, or del annotation.layer; links and widgets have the same property.
- Annot.set_opacity -> Annotation.opacity: Assign annotation.opacity = 0.5.
- Annot.set_open -> Annotation.is_open: Assign annotation.is_open = True or False.
- Annot.set_popup -> Annotation.popup_rect: Assign annotation.popup_rect = rect to add or move the popup; del annotation.popup_rect removes it.
- Annot.set_rect -> Annotation.rect: Assign annotation.rect = Rect(...) in display coordinates; lines and polygons move with annotation.vertices instead.
- Annot.set_rotation -> Annotation.rotation: Assign annotation.rotation, the clockwise turn as the page is displayed, to free text, stamps, carets, and file attachments.
- Annot.type -> Annotation.type: annotation.type is an AnnotationType member; annotation.obj['Subtype'] holds the name and annotation.intent the intent.
- Annot.update -> Annotation: pylopdf has no update(): each property assignment changes the annotation and draws its appearance at once.
- Annot.update_file -> AnnotationFile.write: annotation.file.write(data) replaces the embedded file's data; assign annotation.file.filename and .description for filename= and desc=.
- Annot.vertices -> Annotation.vertices: annotation.vertices lists the display Points of a line, polygon, or polyline; an ink annotation's points are annotation.strokes, one tuple of Points per stroke.
- Annot.xref -> Annotation.xref: Read annotation.xref.
- Base14_fontdict -> Font.standard: Font.standard(name) takes the PostScript name of a Standard 14 font, such as "Helvetica" for pymupdf's "helv".
- Base14_fontnames -> StandardFontName: typing.get_args(pylopdf.StandardFontName) lists the 14 PostScript names that Font.standard() takes.
- CS_* -> Colorspace: CS_RGB and CS_GRAY are Colorspace.RGB and Colorspace.GRAY; CMYK is not rendered.
- Colorspace -> Colorspace: Colorspace is an enum: Colorspace.RGB and Colorspace.GRAY replace Colorspace(CS_RGB) and Colorspace(CS_GRAY).
- DisplayList -> Content: Use the Content that page.content() returns; it records the page's items once and can be read any number of times.
- DisplayList.rect -> Page.rect: Read page.rect, the display area in which the content items are positioned.
- Document.FormFonts -> Document.catalog: list(doc.catalog['AcroForm']['DR']['Font']) names the form's font resources; doc.form.font chooses the face that fills draw with.
- Document.__contains__ -> Pages.__contains__: Test page in doc.pages, which takes Page views.
- Document.__delitem__ -> Pages.__delitem__: Use del doc.pages[i] or del doc.pages[a:b].
- Document.__getitem__ -> Pages.__getitem__: Use doc.pages[i]; doc.pages also takes slices.
- Document.__len__ -> Pages.__len__: Use len(doc.pages).
- Document.add_layer -> LayerConfigurations.add: Use doc.layers.configurations.add(name, creator=..., on=[...]); it returns a LayerConfiguration handle.
- Document.add_ocg -> Layers.add: Use doc.layers.add(name, visible=on, intent=("View",)); intent is a tuple of names, and the handle replaces the returned xref.
- Document.authenticate -> Document.unlock: Use doc.unlock(password), which returns Access.USER or Access.OWNER and raises PasswordError for a wrong password.
- Document.bake -> Document.flatten: doc.flatten(annotations=True, widgets=True) draws appearances into page content and removes the annotations, keeping links; the codemod rewrites bake() calls.
- Document.convert_to_pdf -> Document.to_bytes: A pylopdf Document is always a PDF, so doc.to_bytes() returns its file; to convert images or a CBZ archive, use the images_to_pdf and cbz_to_pdf recipes of the ecosystem guide.
- Document.copy_page -> Pages.insert: Use doc.pages.insert(to, doc.pages[i]); the copy is a new page object, not a second reference.
- Document.del_toc_item -> OutlineItem.destination: pymupdf grays the item out and removes its target: set destination = None, color, and italic on the OutlineItem from doc.outline.walk(), or assign doc.outline without the entry.
- Document.del_xml_metadata -> Document.xmp: del doc.xmp removes the catalog's XMP metadata entry.
- Document.delete_page -> Pages.__delitem__: Use del doc.pages[i].
- Document.delete_pages -> Pages.__delitem__: Use del doc.pages[a:b], or doc.pages.select(...) to keep the other pages.
- Document.embfile_add -> Document.attachments: Use doc.attachments.add(name, data, filename=..., description=...).
- Document.embfile_count -> Document.attachments: Use len(doc.attachments).
- Document.embfile_del -> Document.attachments: Use del doc.attachments[name].
- Document.embfile_get -> Document.attachments: Use doc.attachments[name].read().
- Document.embfile_info -> Document.attachments: Read name, filename, description, size, created, and modified from doc.attachments[name]; absent dates and descriptions read as None.
- Document.embfile_names -> Document.attachments: Use list(doc.attachments).
- Document.embfile_upd -> Document.attachments: Use doc.attachments[name].write(data), which also sets modified; assign filename and description on the handle for filename=, ufilename=, and desc=.
- Document.extract_font -> FontObject.extract: Call doc.fonts[xref].extract(), which returns a FontProgram with format and data, or None for a font that is not embedded; read name and subtype from the FontObject.
- Document.extract_image -> ImageObject.extract: Use doc.images[xref].extract(), which returns an EncodedImage with format, data, and resolution; the size, color space, filters, and masks are properties of doc.images[xref].
- Document.ez_save -> Document.save: Use doc.save(path, dedupe=True, renumber=True, object_streams=True), the options that ez_save's defaults stand for.
- Document.fullcopy_page -> Pages.insert: Use doc.pages.insert(to, doc.pages[i]), or doc.pages.extend(doc.pages[i]) to append.
- Document.get_char_widths -> FontObject.widths: Read doc.fonts[xref].widths, the advance of every character code in em, indexed by code.
- Document.get_layer -> LayerConfiguration: Read doc.layers.configurations[i]: base_state, on, off, locked, and radio_groups hold Layer handles; index 0 is the default configuration, where pymupdf used -1.
- Document.get_layers -> Layers.configurations: Use doc.layers.configurations: LayerConfiguration handles with name and creator, the default configuration first, instead of dictionaries numbered from 0 that leave the default out.
- Document.get_new_xref -> Objects.add: Call doc.objects.add(value), which creates the object and returns its object number.
- Document.get_oc -> ImageObject.layer: Read doc.images[xref].layer for an image; for a Form XObject read doc.objects[xref].get("OC").
- Document.get_ocgs -> Document.layers: Use doc.layers: Layer handles with name, intent, is_visible, and xref, in /OCGs order, instead of a dictionary keyed by xref.
- Document.get_ocmd -> LayerMembership: Read the layer property of the annotation, link, widget, or image, or page.resources.layers: a membership reads as a LayerMembership(layers, policy=..., expression=...) value.
- Document.get_outline_xrefs -> OutlineItem.xref: Use [item.xref for item in doc.outline.walk()].
- Document.get_page_fonts -> Resources.fonts: Read doc.pages[i].resources.fonts, FontObject handles with xref, name, subtype, encoding, and is_embedded instead of tuples.
- Document.get_page_images -> Page.resources: Use doc.pages[i].resources.images.
- Document.get_page_labels -> Document.page_labels: Read doc.page_labels, a list of PageLabelRange(start, style, prefix, first) records.
- Document.get_page_numbers -> Pages.labeled: Use doc.pages.labeled(label).
- Document.get_page_pixmap -> Page.pixmap: Use doc.pages[i].pixmap(...).
- Document.get_page_text -> Page.text: Use doc.pages[i].text(), or words() and layout() for the other options.
- Document.get_page_xobjects -> Resources.forms: Read doc.pages[i].resources.forms, FormObject handles with xref, bbox, and matrix instead of tuples.
- Document.get_sigflags -> Form.signature_flags: doc.form.signature_flags is a SignatureFlags value, empty where pymupdf returns -1 for a document without a form.
- Document.get_toc -> Document.outline: Use doc.outline.entries(): OutlineEntry records whose destination is a Destination with a zero-based page (entry.page); get_toc used one-based pages.
- Document.get_xml_metadata -> Document.xmp: doc.xmp returns the XMP packet as text, or None without one where pymupdf returns an empty string.
- Document.has_annots -> Page.annotations: any(page.annotations for page in doc.pages)
- Document.has_links -> Page.links: any(page.links for page in doc.pages)
- Document.insert_file -> Pages.extend: doc.pages.extend(pylopdf.open(path).pages) appends a PDF's pages; an image becomes a page with the images_to_pdf recipe of the ecosystem guide, or with canvas.image on doc.pages.new(size).
- Document.insert_page -> Pages.new: Use page = doc.pages.new(size, index=i), then draw the text inside with page.draw() as canvas: canvas.text(text, at).
- Document.insert_pdf -> Pages.insert: Use doc.pages.insert(index, other.pages[a:b + 1]), or doc.pages.extend(other.pages) to append.
- Document.is_encrypted -> Document.needs_password: Read doc.needs_password, which is true until unlock() succeeds.
- Document.is_form_pdf -> Document.form: len(doc.form) counts the form's fields; an empty doc.form means no form.
- Document.is_stream -> Stream: Check isinstance(doc.objects[xref], pylopdf.Stream).
- Document.journal_can_do -> History.can_undo: Read doc.history.can_undo and doc.history.can_redo.
- Document.journal_enable -> Document.history: Nothing to enable: every with doc.transaction(name): block records one step in doc.history, within doc.history.max_size bytes.
- Document.journal_is_enabled -> Document.history: doc.history is always available; transactions record its steps.
- Document.journal_op_name -> History.steps: Use doc.history.steps[step], the names of the recorded transactions, oldest first.
- Document.journal_position -> History.position: Use doc.history.position, the number of applied steps, and len(doc.history.steps).
- Document.journal_redo -> History.redo: Use doc.history.redo().
- Document.journal_start_op -> Document.transaction: Wrap the edits in with doc.transaction(name):, which records one step and undoes the block when it raises.
- Document.journal_stop_op -> Document.transaction: Wrap the edits in with doc.transaction(name):, which records one step when the block ends.
- Document.journal_undo -> History.undo: Use doc.history.undo(), which undoes the latest doc.transaction() block.
- Document.layer_ui_configs -> LayerConfiguration.order: Walk doc.layers.configurations[0].order: Layer handles and LayerOrder(label, items) values; a layer in one of radio_groups shows as a radio button.
- Document.load_page -> Pages.__getitem__: Use doc.pages[i].
- Document.markinfo -> Document.mark_info: doc.mark_info returns a MarkInfo record with marked, user_properties, and suspects, or None; assign a MarkInfo to replace it.
- Document.move_page -> Pages.move: Use doc.pages.move(i, to); to is the index where the page ends up, where pymupdf inserted before page to.
- Document.name -> Document.path: Read doc.path, a pathlib.Path, or None for a document opened from bytes or created empty.
- Document.need_appearances -> Form.need_appearances: doc.form.need_appearances reads and sets /NeedAppearances.
- Document.needs_pass -> Document.needs_password: Read doc.needs_password, which is true until unlock() succeeds; pymupdf's needs_pass stays true after authentication.
- Document.new_page -> Pages.new: Use doc.pages.new((width, height), index=i); without index the page is appended.
- Document.page_annot_xrefs -> Annotation.xref: [(annotation.xref, annotation.type) for annotation in doc.pages[n].annotations]
- Document.page_count -> Pages.__len__: Use len(doc.pages).
- Document.page_cropbox -> PageBoxes.crop: Read doc.pages[i].boxes.crop, in PDF user space as stored.
- Document.page_xref -> Page.xref: Use doc.pages[i].xref.
- Document.pagelayout -> Document.page_layout: doc.page_layout returns a PageLayout, SinglePage when unset.
- Document.pagemode -> Document.page_mode: doc.page_mode returns a PageMode, UseNone when unset.
- Document.pages -> Document.pages: doc.pages is a sequence; slice it, as in doc.pages[start:stop:step], instead of calling it.
- Document.pdf_catalog -> Document.catalog: Use doc.catalog, a live dictionary handle; doc.catalog.xref is its object number.
- Document.pdf_trailer -> Document.trailer: Use doc.trailer, a live dictionary handle, instead of its PDF syntax.
- Document.reload_page -> Pages.__getitem__: Fetch the page again with doc.pages[page.index].
- Document.repair -> open: pylopdf repairs damaged cross-reference data when it opens a document and reports it with doc.is_repaired; saving writes the repaired structure.
- Document.resolve_link -> Document.destinations: For a named destination, doc.destinations[name]; for '#page=N', Destination(N - 1); links and the outline already read their targets resolved.
- Document.resolve_names -> Document.destinations: doc.destinations maps each named destination to its Destination(page, point, zoom), or None when it names no page.
- Document.saveIncr -> Document.save: Use doc.save(path, incremental=True), which appends one update to the bytes the document was opened from and may write to any path.
- Document.scrub -> Document.sanitize: doc.sanitize(links=True, form_values=True) removes what scrub() removes by default; javascript= is scripts=, attached_files= and embedded_files= are embedded_files=, xml_metadata= goes with metadata=, remove_links= is links=, reset_fields= is form_values=, and redactions=True is page.redact() on every page.
- Document.search_page_for -> Page.search: Call doc.pages[i].search(text).
- Document.select -> Pages.select: Use doc.pages.select(indexes).
- Document.set_language -> Document.language: Assign doc.language = tag, or del doc.language to remove it; pylopdf keeps the complete BCP 47 tag, such as zh-TW, where pymupdf keeps at most three letters.
- Document.set_layer -> LayerConfiguration: Assign base_state, on, off, locked, or radio_groups on doc.layers.configurations[i]; each takes Layer handles instead of xrefs.
- Document.set_layer_ui_config -> Layer.is_visible: Assign layer.is_visible on the handle from doc.layers; showing a layer hides the others of its radio-button groups.
- Document.set_markinfo -> Document.mark_info: Assign doc.mark_info = MarkInfo(marked=..., user_properties=..., suspects=...); flags left out are written false, as in pymupdf.
- Document.set_metadata -> Document.metadata: doc.metadata is a live mapping of the entries present: assign or update() keys to store values, del a key to remove it; created and modified replace creationDate and modDate.
- Document.set_oc -> ImageObject.layer: Assign a Layer or LayerMembership to doc.images[xref].layer, or del it; for a Form XObject assign doc.objects[xref]["OC"] = layer.obj.
- Document.set_ocmd -> LayerMembership: Assign LayerMembership(layers, policy=VisibilityPolicy.ALL_ON, expression=LayerExpression(...)) to a layer property; each assignment writes a new membership dictionary.
- Document.set_page_labels -> Document.page_labels: Assign a list of PageLabelRange(start, style, prefix, first) records to doc.page_labels.
- Document.set_pagelayout -> Document.page_layout: Assign doc.page_layout = PageLayout.TWO_COLUMN_LEFT or its exact name, such as "TwoColumnLeft".
- Document.set_pagemode -> Document.page_mode: Assign doc.page_mode = PageMode.USE_OUTLINES or its exact name, such as "UseOutlines".
- Document.set_toc -> Document.outline: Assign a list of OutlineEntry(level, title, Destination(page)) records to doc.outline; pages are zero-based, where set_toc took one-based pages.
- Document.set_toc_item -> OutlineItem: Assign title, destination, color, bold, italic, or is_open on the OutlineItem from doc.outline.walk().
- Document.set_xml_metadata -> Document.xmp: Assign doc.xmp = packet to rewrite or add the XMP metadata stream.
- Document.switch_layer -> LayerConfiguration.apply: Use doc.layers.configurations[i].apply(), which makes the configuration the default that rendering, extraction, and viewers use.
- Document.to_markdown -> Document.markdown: Call doc.markdown(...).
- Document.to_text -> Document.text: Call doc.text() for the plain text of every page.
- Document.tobytes -> Document.to_bytes: Use doc.to_bytes(...), which takes the options of save() and a max_size bound.
- Document.update_object -> Document.objects: Assign a typed value to doc.objects[xref] instead of PDF syntax.
- Document.update_stream -> Stream.write: Call doc.objects[xref].write(data), which Flate-compresses unless filter=None.
- Document.write -> Document.to_bytes: Use doc.to_bytes(...), which takes the options of save() and a max_size bound.
- Document.xref_copy -> Document.objects: Assign doc.objects[source] to doc.objects[target], which copies the object.
- Document.xref_get_key -> Dictionary: Use doc.objects[xref].get(key), which returns a typed value instead of a (type, syntax) pair.
- Document.xref_get_keys -> Dictionary: Use list(doc.objects[xref]), whose keys carry no leading slash.
- Document.xref_is_font -> Dictionary: Check doc.objects[xref].get('Type') == 'Font'.
- Document.xref_is_image -> Images: Check xref in doc.images.
- Document.xref_is_stream -> Stream: Check isinstance(doc.objects[xref], pylopdf.Stream).
- Document.xref_is_xobject -> Dictionary: Check doc.objects[xref].get('Type') == 'XObject'.
- Document.xref_length -> Document.objects: Use max(doc.objects) + 1; len(doc.objects) counts the object numbers in use.
- Document.xref_object -> Document.objects: Use doc.objects[xref], a typed value or handle, instead of its PDF syntax.
- Document.xref_set_key -> Dictionary: Assign doc.objects[xref][key] = value with a typed value, such as pylopdf.Name('Page') for a name.
- Document.xref_stream -> Stream.read: Use doc.objects[xref].read().
- Document.xref_stream_raw -> Stream.read: Use doc.objects[xref].read(decode=False).
- Document.xref_xml_metadata -> Document.catalog: Use doc.catalog.get('Metadata'), a Stream whose xref is the metadata object number.
- DocumentWriter -> Builder: Call pylopdf.create(), draw each page in a `with builder.page(size) as canvas:` block, and write the document with builder.to_bytes() or builder.finish().
- DocumentWriter.__enter__ -> Builder.page: Draw each page in a `with builder.page(size) as canvas:` block; the block adds the page when it ends.
- DocumentWriter.__exit__ -> Builder.to_bytes: Write the document with builder.to_bytes(), or open it with builder.finish().
- DocumentWriter.begin_page -> Builder.page: Use `with builder.page(size) as canvas:`; the canvas draws the page and the block adds it.
- DocumentWriter.close -> Builder.to_bytes: Write the document with builder.to_bytes(), or open it with builder.finish().
- DocumentWriter.end_page -> Builder.page: The `with builder.page(size) as canvas:` block adds the page when it ends.
- EMPTY_* -> Rect.EMPTY: EMPTY_RECT(), EMPTY_IRECT(), and EMPTY_QUAD() are the class attributes Rect.EMPTY, IRect.EMPTY, and Quad.EMPTY.
- EmptyFileError -> MalformedPdfError: Catch MalformedPdfError, which empty input raises.
- FZ_MAX_INF_RECT -> Rect.INFINITE: Read Rect.INFINITE.x1, the upper coordinate bound of the infinite rectangle.
- FZ_MIN_INF_RECT -> Rect.INFINITE: Read Rect.INFINITE.x0, the lower coordinate bound of the infinite rectangle.
- FileDataError -> MalformedPdfError: Catch MalformedPdfError, a PdfError and thus a ValueError, which empty input raises as well.
- FileNotFoundError -> FileNotFoundError: Catch Python's built-in FileNotFoundError, which pylopdf raises for a missing file.
- Font.buffer -> Font.program: font.program() returns the bytes that an OpenType face was loaded from, or None for a Standard 14 font, which is not embedded.
- Font.char_lengths -> Font.char_widths: font.char_widths(text, size) returns the advance of each character drawn alone as a tuple; size has no default.
- Font.flags -> Font.is_monospaced: Read font.is_bold, font.is_italic, font.is_serif, and font.is_monospaced; pylopdf never imitates bold or italic, so there are no fake flags.
- Font.glyph_advance -> Font.char_widths: font.char_widths(char, 1)[0] is a character's advance in fractions of the em; it takes the character, not its code point.
- Font.glyph_bbox -> Font.char_bbox: font.char_bbox(char) takes the character, not its code point, and returns its glyph's ink box in fractions of the em, y upward.
- Font.glyph_name_to_unicode -> glyph_text: pylopdf.glyph_text(name) returns the text that a glyph name stands for by the Adobe Glyph List, "" for none, whatever the font.
- Font.text_length -> Font.text_width: font.text_width(text, size) measures one line with the shaping that drawing uses; size has no default, and a line break raises.
- Font.unicode_to_glyph_name -> glyph_name: pylopdf.glyph_name(char) takes the character and returns its Adobe Glyph List name, whatever the font.
- Font.valid_codepoints -> Font.chars: font.chars() returns every character the font has a glyph for as one string; [ord(c) for c in font.chars()] gives the code points.
- INFINITE_* -> Rect.INFINITE: INFINITE_RECT(), INFINITE_IRECT(), and INFINITE_QUAD() are the class attributes Rect.INFINITE, IRect.INFINITE, and Quad.INFINITE.
- IRect.__setitem__ -> IRect: IRect values are immutable; build a new IRect instead.
- IRect.include_point -> IRect.__or__: Use r | p, which returns a new IRect.
- IRect.include_rect -> IRect.__or__: Use r | other, which returns a new IRect.
- IRect.intersect -> IRect.__and__: Use r & other, which returns a new IRect.
- IRect.normalize -> IRect.normalized: Use r.normalized(), which returns a new IRect.
- IRect.transform -> IRect.__mul__: Use r * m, which returns a new IRect.
- Identity -> Matrix.IDENTITY: Use Matrix.IDENTITY.
- IdentityMatrix -> Matrix.IDENTITY: IdentityMatrix() is Matrix.IDENTITY, an ordinary Matrix.
- LINK_FLAG_* -> Destination: A Destination's point and zoom are None where the destination leaves them unset.
- LINK_GOTO -> Destination: isinstance(link.target, Destination) marks a link to a page of this document.
- LINK_GOTOR -> RemoteDestination: isinstance(link.target, RemoteDestination) marks a link to another PDF file.
- LINK_LAUNCH -> Launch: isinstance(link.target, Launch) marks a link that opens a file.
- LINK_NAMED -> NamedAction: isinstance(link.target, NamedAction) marks a named viewer action.
- LINK_NONE -> Link.target: link.target is None for a link that pylopdf cannot follow.
- LINK_URI -> Link.target: isinstance(link.target, str) marks a URI link.
- Link.border -> Link.obj: Read or assign link.obj["Border"] or link.obj["BS"], the annotation's border entries.
- Link.colors -> Link.obj: Read or assign link.obj["C"], the annotation's border colour.
- Link.dest -> Link.target: link.target is a URI string, Destination(page, point, zoom), RemoteDestination(file, page), Launch(file), or NamedAction(name), or None for an action that pylopdf does not read.
- Link.flags -> Link.obj: Read or assign link.obj["F"], the annotation flags.
- Link.id -> Link.obj: link.obj["NM"] holds the annotation's name.
- Link.is_external -> Link.target: isinstance(link.target, (str, RemoteDestination, Launch)) tells whether a link leaves the document.
- Link.next -> Links: Iterate page.links instead of following link.next.
- Link.page -> Link.target: link.target.page is the zero-based page of a Destination; link.page is the page that holds the link.
- Link.parent -> Link.page: link.page is the page that holds the link.
- Link.set_border -> Link.obj: Read or assign link.obj["Border"] or link.obj["BS"], the annotation's border entries.
- Link.set_colors -> Link.obj: Read or assign link.obj["C"], the annotation's border colour.
- Link.set_flags -> Link.obj: Read or assign link.obj["F"], the annotation flags.
- Link.uri -> Link.target: link.target is the URI string of a URI link.
- Matrix.__setitem__ -> Matrix: Matrix values are immutable; build a new Matrix instead.
- Matrix.concat -> Matrix.__mul__: Use one * two, which returns a new Matrix.
- Matrix.invert -> Matrix.__invert__: Use ~m, which returns the inverse.
- Matrix.prerotate -> Matrix.__mul__: Use pylopdf.Matrix(deg) * m, which returns a new Matrix.
- Matrix.prescale -> Matrix.__mul__: Use pylopdf.Matrix(sx, sy) * m, which returns a new Matrix.
- Matrix.preshear -> Matrix.__mul__: Use pylopdf.Matrix(h, v, 1) * m, which returns a new Matrix.
- Matrix.pretranslate -> Matrix.__mul__: Use pylopdf.Matrix(1, 0, 0, 1, tx, ty) * m, which returns a new Matrix.
- Outline -> OutlineItem: pymupdf's Outline is one item; pylopdf's is OutlineItem, and pylopdf's Outline is the sequence that doc.outline returns.
- Outline.dest -> OutlineItem.destination: Read item.destination: a Destination, RemoteDestination, Launch, NamedAction, URI string, or None.
- Outline.destination -> OutlineItem.destination: Read item.destination; a named destination reads as the Destination it names.
- Outline.down -> OutlineItem.children: Read item.children, the item's children in order.
- Outline.is_external -> OutlineItem.destination: Test item.destination: a RemoteDestination, a Launch, or a URI string leads outside the document.
- Outline.is_open -> OutlineItem.is_open: Read or assign item.is_open on the OutlineItem; assigning recounts the outline.
- Outline.next -> OutlineItem.children: Iterate over doc.outline or the parent's item.children; doc.outline.walk() visits every item.
- Outline.page -> OutlineItem.page: Read item.page: zero-based, and None for a target outside the document, where pymupdf returns -1.
- Outline.title -> OutlineItem.title: Read or assign item.title on the OutlineItem.
- Outline.uri -> OutlineItem.destination: Read item.destination: a URI target reads as its string.
- Outline.x -> OutlineItem.destination: Read item.destination.point.x of a Destination with a point.
- Outline.y -> OutlineItem.destination: Read item.destination.point.y of a Destination with a point.
- PDF_ANNOT_* -> AnnotationType: PDF_ANNOT_TEXT is AnnotationType.TEXT, and so on; PDF_ANNOT_3D is AnnotationType.THREE_D.
- PDF_ANNOT_IS_* -> AnnotationFlags: PDF_ANNOT_IS_HIDDEN is AnnotationFlags.HIDDEN, and so on.
- PDF_ANNOT_IT_* -> Annotation.intent: annotation.intent is the /IT name, such as 'FreeTextCallout'; FreeText with a callout writes it.
- PDF_ANNOT_LE_* -> LineEnding: Line endings such as PDF_ANNOT_LE_ClosedArrow are LineEnding members such as LineEnding.CLOSED_ARROW.
- PDF_ANNOT_Q_* -> FreeText: Free-text alignments are FreeText(align='left' | 'center' | 'right') strings.
- PDF_BM_* -> BlendMode: Blend modes such as PDF_BM_Multiply are BlendMode members such as BlendMode.MULTIPLY; annotation specifications take blend_mode=.
- PDF_BORDER_* -> BorderStyle: PDF_BORDER_STYLE_* are BorderStyle members, which the codemod rewrites; PDF_BORDER_EFFECT_CLOUDY is the clouds intensity (0 to 2) of Square, Circle, and Polygon, read and set as annotation.clouds.
- PDF_BTN_FIELD_IS_* -> FieldFlags: Button field flags such as PDF_BTN_FIELD_IS_RADIO and PDF_BTN_FIELD_IS_PUSHBUTTON are FieldFlags members such as FieldFlags.RADIO and PUSHBUTTON.
- PDF_CH_FIELD_IS_* -> FieldFlags: Choice field flags such as PDF_CH_FIELD_IS_COMBO and PDF_CH_FIELD_IS_MULTI_SELECT are FieldFlags members such as FieldFlags.COMBO and MULTI_SELECT.
- PDF_ENCRYPT_* -> Encryption: Pass encryption=Encryption(user_password=..., owner_password=..., permissions=...) to save() or to_bytes(), which writes AES-256, or add method="aes-128"; encryption=Encryption.KEEP keeps the input's AES encryption, and encryption=None, the default, writes none where pymupdf kept it. RC4 is not written.
- PDF_FIELD_IS_* -> FieldFlags: PDF_FIELD_IS_READ_ONLY, PDF_FIELD_IS_REQUIRED, and PDF_FIELD_IS_NO_EXPORT are FieldFlags.READ_ONLY, REQUIRED, and NO_EXPORT, which doc.form[name].flags returns.
- PDF_LAYER_UI_* -> LayerOrder: A LayerOrder with a label is a label entry, a layer in one of the configuration's radio_groups a radio button, and any other layer a check box.
- PDF_OC_* -> Layer.is_visible: Assign layer.is_visible = True or False; toggle with layer.is_visible = not layer.is_visible.
- PDF_PAGE_LABEL_* -> PageLabelStyle: PageLabelStyle members name the label styles, such as PageLabelStyle.LOWER_ROMAN for PDF_PAGE_LABEL_ROMAN_LC; PageLabelRange(style=None) labels with the prefix only, for PDF_PAGE_LABEL_NONE.
- PDF_PERM_* -> Permissions: PDF_PERM_PRINT is Permissions.PRINT, and so on.
- PDF_REDACT_* -> Page.redact: Page.redact takes strings: images="pixels", "remove", or "keep"; graphics="touched", "covered", or "keep"; text="remove" or "keep".
- PDF_TX_FIELD_IS_* -> FieldFlags: Text field flags such as PDF_TX_FIELD_IS_MULTILINE and PDF_TX_FIELD_IS_COMB are FieldFlags members such as FieldFlags.MULTILINE and COMB.
- PDF_WIDGET_TX_FORMAT_* -> Field.scripts: Text formats are Acrobat scripts: set field.scripts[ScriptTrigger.FORMAT] and [ScriptTrigger.KEYSTROKE], for example to AFDate_FormatEx("yyyy-mm-dd").
- PDF_WIDGET_TYPE_* -> FieldType: doc.form[name].type is a FieldType member: TEXT, CHECKBOX, RADIO, PUSHBUTTON, COMBOBOX, LISTBOX, SIGNATURE, or UNKNOWN.
- Page.add_caret_annot -> Annotations.add: page.annotations.add(Caret(point)) adds a caret in a 20-point square and returns its Annotation.
- Page.add_circle_annot -> Annotations.add: page.annotations.add(Circle(rect, color=..., interior_color=..., border=Border(...))) adds an ellipse with its appearance and returns its Annotation.
- Page.add_file_annot -> Annotations.add: page.annotations.add(FileAttachment(point, data, filename=..., description=..., icon=AttachmentIcon.PUSH_PIN)) embeds a file behind an icon and returns its Annotation.
- Page.add_freetext_annot -> Annotations.add: page.annotations.add(FreeText(rect, text, size=..., text_color=Color(...), color=fill, align='left', rotate=..., callout=[...])) adds free text with its appearance and returns its Annotation.
- Page.add_highlight_annot -> Annotations.add: page.annotations.add(Highlight(quads)) adds a highlight and returns its Annotation; color is a Color and content becomes contents.
- Page.add_ink_annot -> Annotations.add: page.annotations.add(Ink(handwriting, ...)) adds freehand strokes, a sequence of point sequences, with their appearance and returns its Annotation.
- Page.add_line_annot -> Annotations.add: page.annotations.add(LineAnnotation(p1, p2, line_endings=(...), ...)) adds a line with its appearance and returns its Annotation.
- Page.add_polygon_annot -> Annotations.add: page.annotations.add(Polygon(points, ...)) adds a closed polygon with its appearance and returns its Annotation.
- Page.add_polyline_annot -> Annotations.add: page.annotations.add(PolyLine(points, ...)) adds an open polyline with its appearance and returns its Annotation.
- Page.add_rect_annot -> Annotations.add: page.annotations.add(Square(rect, color=..., interior_color=..., border=Border(...))) adds a rectangle with its appearance and returns its Annotation.
- Page.add_redact_annot -> Annotations.add: page.annotations.add(Redaction(quads, fill=Color(...), overlay_text=..., text_color=..., align=...)) marks areas for removal; applying them is page.redact (Rewriting).
- Page.add_squiggly_annot -> Annotations.add: page.annotations.add(Squiggly(quads)) adds a squiggly underline with its appearance and returns its Annotation; color is a Color and content becomes contents.
- Page.add_stamp_annot -> Annotations.add: page.annotations.add(Stamp(rect, icon=StampIcon.APPROVED, rotate=...)) adds a stamp with its appearance and returns its Annotation.
- Page.add_strikeout_annot -> Annotations.add: page.annotations.add(StrikeOut(quads)) adds a strikeout with its appearance and returns its Annotation; color is a Color and content becomes contents.
- Page.add_text_annot -> Annotations.add: page.annotations.add(Note(point, contents=text, icon=NoteIcon.NOTE)) adds a note with its 20-point icon and returns its Annotation.
- Page.add_underline_annot -> Annotations.add: page.annotations.add(Underline(quads)) adds an underline with its appearance and returns its Annotation; color is a Color and content becomes contents.
- Page.add_widget -> Widgets.add: page.widgets.add(TextField(name, rect, ...)) creates a field with its widget; CheckBox, RadioButton, ComboBox, ListBox, PushButton, and SignatureField are the other kinds, and a name that the form has adds a widget to that field.
- Page.annot_names -> Annotation.name: [annotation.name for annotation in page.annotations]
- Page.annot_xrefs -> Annotation.xref: [(annotation.xref, annotation.type) for annotation in page.annotations]
- Page.annots -> Page.annotations: page.annotations lists Annotation handles other than links and widgets; filter on annotation.type instead of passing types.
- Page.apply_redactions -> Page.redact: page.redact() applies the page's Redaction annotations and returns a RedactionReport; page.redact(areas, fill=...) redacts areas without annotations.
- Page.artbox -> Page.boxes: Read page.boxes.art, in PDF user space as stored, where pymupdf flips y against the top of the MediaBox.

- Page.bound -> Page.rect: Read page.rect.
- Page.cluster_drawings -> Content.path_clusters: Call page.content(clip=page.rect, text_runs=False, images=False).path_clusters(x_tolerance=..., y_tolerance=...), which returns the box of each group of nearby paths.
- Page.cropbox -> Page.boxes: Read page.boxes.crop, in PDF user space as stored, where pymupdf flips y against the top of the MediaBox.
- Page.cropbox_position -> Page.boxes: Read page.boxes.crop: its top-left corner is (crop.x0, crop.y1) in PDF user space.
- Page.delete_annot -> Annotations: del page.annotations[index] removes an annotation with its popup.

- Page.derotation_matrix -> Page.user_to_display: pylopdf reads and writes in display space with the rotation resolved; drop the step, and map display space to PDF user space with ~page.user_to_display.
- Page.draw_bezier -> Canvas.bezier: Inside with page.draw() as canvas:, call canvas.bezier(p1, p2, p3, p4, stroke=...), or canvas.path(PathBuilder()...) for a closed or filled curve.
- Page.draw_circle -> Canvas.circle: Inside with page.draw() as canvas:, call canvas.circle(center, radius, fill=..., stroke=...); fill=Color(r, g, b) and stroke=Stroke(paint=Color(r, g, b), width=..., cap=..., join=..., dashes=...) replace color, fill, width, lineCap, lineJoin, and dashes, and a Color's alpha the opacities.
- Page.draw_curve -> Canvas.bezier: Inside with page.draw() as canvas:, call canvas.bezier(p1, c1, c2, p3) with the curve's control points, or build it with PathBuilder.curve_to.
- Page.draw_line -> Canvas.line: Inside with page.draw() as canvas:, call canvas.line(p1, p2, stroke=...); fill=Color(r, g, b) and stroke=Stroke(paint=Color(r, g, b), width=..., cap=..., join=..., dashes=...) replace color, fill, width, lineCap, lineJoin, and dashes, and a Color's alpha the opacities.
- Page.draw_oval -> Canvas.ellipse: Inside with page.draw() as canvas:, call canvas.ellipse(rect, fill=..., stroke=...); draw the ellipse of a quad inside canvas.transform(matrix).
- Page.draw_polyline -> Canvas.polygon: Inside with page.draw() as canvas:, call canvas.polygon(points, close=False, fill=..., stroke=...); fill=Color(r, g, b) and stroke=Stroke(paint=Color(r, g, b), width=..., cap=..., join=..., dashes=...) replace color, fill, width, lineCap, lineJoin, and dashes, and a Color's alpha the opacities.

- Page.draw_rect -> Canvas.rect: Inside with page.draw() as canvas:, call canvas.rect(rect, radius=..., fill=..., stroke=...), whose radius is in points where pymupdf's is a fraction of the shorter side; fill=Color(r, g, b) and stroke=Stroke(paint=Color(r, g, b), width=..., cap=..., join=..., dashes=...) replace color, fill, width, lineCap, lineJoin, and dashes, and a Color's alpha the opacities.

- Page.get_text_blocks -> Page.layout: Read page.layout().blocks, Block records with text, bbox, and lines.
- Page.get_text_selection -> Page.selection: Call page.selection(start, end, clip=...), which returns the text in reading order from the character nearest start to the one nearest end.
- Page.get_text_words -> Page.words: Call page.words(), which returns Word records with text, bbox, block, line, and index.

- Page.get_texttrace -> Page.content: Call page.content() and read the glyphs of its text_runs, each run with its font, size, paints, and graphics context.

- Page.insert_image -> Canvas.image: Inside with page.draw() as canvas:, call canvas.image(rect, source, keep_aspect=..., rotate=...), with a path, encoded JPEG or PNG bytes, or a Pixmap as source in place of filename=, stream=, and pixmap=, and doc.images[xref] in place of xref=; an image drawn again is stored once, and page.content().images reports each placement's xref.
- Page.insert_link -> Links.add: page.links.add(rect, target), where target is a URI string, Destination(page, point, zoom), RemoteDestination(file, page), Launch(file), or NamedAction(name).
- Page.insert_text -> Canvas.text: Inside with page.draw() as canvas:, call canvas.text(text, point, font=..., size=..., fill=Color(r, g, b)), with a Font from Font.standard(), Font.from_file(), or Font.installed(); it draws every line, line_height times size apart, and rotate= turns them clockwise about the point, so pymupdf's rotate=90 is rotate=270.
- Page.insert_textbox -> Canvas.textbox: Inside with page.draw() as canvas:, call canvas.textbox(rect, text, font=..., size=..., align="left"), which returns a TextFit whose spare_height, like pymupdf's return value, is negative when nothing was drawn; Font.text_height(text, size, width=...) measures the height the text needs before drawing; rotate= turns the text clockwise inside the rectangle, so pymupdf's rotate=90 is rotate=270.

- Page.links -> Page.links: page.links is a sequence of Link handles: iterate it instead of calling it, and test the type of link.target instead of passing kinds.
- Page.load_annot -> Page.annotations: Find the annotation in page.annotations by its xref or name.

- Page.number -> Page.index: Read page.index.

- Page.read_contents -> Page.operations: page.operations.to_bytes() returns the page content as the renderer joins its streams; page.obj["Contents"] holds the streams themselves.

- Page.run -> Page.content: Call page.content() for the items that the page paints; pylopdf has no device protocol.
- Page.search_for -> Page.search: Use page.search(text), which returns one Rect per match, or one Quad per line of a match with quads=True.
- Page.set_artbox -> Page.boxes: Assign page.boxes.art = rect, in PDF user space as stored, where pymupdf flips y against the top of the MediaBox.
- Page.set_bleedbox -> Page.boxes: Assign page.boxes.bleed = rect, in PDF user space as stored, where pymupdf flips y against the top of the MediaBox.
- Page.set_contents -> Page.operations: Assign page.operations = Operations.parse(data) to replace the page content with one new stream; to point /Contents at an existing stream, assign page.obj["Contents"] = doc.objects[xref].
- Page.set_cropbox -> Page.boxes: Assign page.boxes.crop = rect, in PDF user space as stored, where pymupdf flips y against the top of the MediaBox.
- Page.set_mediabox -> Page.boxes: Assign page.boxes.media = rect; as in pymupdf, the other boxes are removed.
- Page.set_rotation -> Page.rotation: Assign page.rotation = angle, a multiple of 90; another angle raises ValueError, where pymupdf sets 0.
- Page.set_trimbox -> Page.boxes: Assign page.boxes.trim = rect, in PDF user space as stored, where pymupdf flips y against the top of the MediaBox.
- Page.show_pdf_page -> Canvas.page: Inside with page.draw() as canvas:, call canvas.page(rect, docsrc.pages[pno], clip=..., keep_aspect=..., rotate=...), which draws the page as vectors, from any open document or this one; clip is in the source page's display coordinates, and rotate turns clockwise, so pymupdf's rotate=90 is rotate=270.
- Page.transformation_matrix -> Page.user_to_display: Use page.user_to_display, which maps PDF user space to display space with the rotation included; pymupdf's matrix stops before the rotation.
- Page.trimbox -> Page.boxes: Read page.boxes.trim, in PDF user space as stored, where pymupdf flips y against the top of the MediaBox.
- Page.update_link -> Link.target: Assign link.rect and link.target on a handle from page.links.
- Page.widgets -> Page.widgets: page.widgets is a sequence of Widget handles; filter by widget.field.type for pymupdf's types=.
- Page.wrap_contents -> Page.operations: page.draw() isolates unbalanced content in q and Q by itself; to wrap explicitly, assign page.operations = [Operation("q"), *page.operations, Operation("Q")].
- Pixmap.h -> Pixmap.height: Read pix.height.
- Pixmap.n -> Pixmap.channels: Read pix.channels.
- Pixmap.pdfocr_save -> Page.apply_ocr: Draw the image on a page, with canvas.image on doc.pages.new(size) or the images_to_pdf recipe of the ecosystem guide, run page.apply_ocr(), and save the document.
- Pixmap.pdfocr_tobytes -> Page.apply_ocr: Draw the image on a page, with canvas.image on doc.pages.new(size) or the images_to_pdf recipe of the ecosystem guide, run page.apply_ocr(), and call doc.to_bytes().
- Pixmap.samples -> Pixmap: bytes(pix) copies the pixels; memoryview(pix) and numpy.asarray(pix) read them without a copy, shaped (height, width, channels).
- Pixmap.samples_mv -> Pixmap: Use memoryview(pix), shaped (height, width, channels).
- Pixmap.set_dpi -> Pixmap.from_array: A Pixmap is immutable: pix = Pixmap.from_array(pix, resolution=(xres, yres)) shares the pixels at the new resolution.
- Pixmap.tobytes -> Pixmap.to_bytes: Use pix.to_bytes('png') or pix.to_bytes('jpeg', quality=...); other formats belong to Pillow.
- Pixmap.w -> Pixmap.width: Read pix.width.
- Pixmap.xres -> Pixmap.resolution: Read pix.resolution[0].
- Pixmap.yres -> Pixmap.resolution: Read pix.resolution[1].
- Point.__setitem__ -> Point: Point values are immutable; build a new Point instead.
- Point.transform -> Point.__mul__: Use p * m, which returns a new Point.
- Quad.__setitem__ -> Quad: Quad values are immutable; build a new Quad instead.
- Quad.transform -> Quad.__mul__: Use q * m, which returns a new Quad.
- Rect.__setitem__ -> Rect: Rect values are immutable; build a new Rect instead.
- Rect.include_point -> Rect.__or__: Use r | p, which returns a new Rect.
- Rect.include_rect -> Rect.__or__: Use r | other, which returns a new Rect.
- Rect.intersect -> Rect.__and__: Use r & other, which returns a new Rect.
- Rect.normalize -> Rect.normalized: Use r.normalized(), which returns a new Rect.
- Rect.transform -> Rect.__mul__: Use r * m, which returns a new Rect.
- STAMP_* -> StampIcon: Stamps such as STAMP_Approved are StampIcon members such as StampIcon.APPROVED, in the same order.
- Shape -> Canvas: page.draw() returns a Canvas, a context manager that draws paths, text, images, and pages in the order of the calls and writes them as one Form XObject when its with block ends.
- Shape.commit -> Canvas: The canvas's with block writes the drawing when it ends; page.draw(underlay=True) writes it below the page's content.
- Shape.draw_bezier -> Canvas.bezier: canvas.bezier(p1, p2, p3, p4, stroke=...), or canvas.path(PathBuilder()...) for a closed or filled curve.
- Shape.draw_circle -> Canvas.circle: canvas.circle(center, radius, fill=..., stroke=...); fill=Color(r, g, b) and stroke=Stroke(paint=Color(r, g, b), width=..., cap=..., join=..., dashes=...) replace color, fill, width, lineCap, lineJoin, and dashes, and a Color's alpha the opacities.
- Shape.draw_curve -> Canvas.bezier: canvas.bezier(p1, c1, c2, p3) with the curve's control points, or build it with PathBuilder.curve_to.
- Shape.draw_line -> Canvas.line: canvas.line(p1, p2, stroke=...); fill=Color(r, g, b) and stroke=Stroke(paint=Color(r, g, b), width=..., cap=..., join=..., dashes=...) replace color, fill, width, lineCap, lineJoin, and dashes, and a Color's alpha the opacities.
- Shape.draw_oval -> Canvas.ellipse: canvas.ellipse(rect, fill=..., stroke=...); draw the ellipse of a quad inside canvas.transform(matrix).
- Shape.draw_polyline -> Canvas.polygon: canvas.polygon(points, close=False, fill=..., stroke=...); fill=Color(r, g, b) and stroke=Stroke(paint=Color(r, g, b), width=..., cap=..., join=..., dashes=...) replace color, fill, width, lineCap, lineJoin, and dashes, and a Color's alpha the opacities.
- Shape.draw_quad -> Canvas.polygon: canvas.polygon((quad.ul, quad.ur, quad.lr, quad.ll), fill=..., stroke=...).
- Shape.draw_rect -> Canvas.rect: canvas.rect(rect, radius=..., fill=..., stroke=...), whose radius is in points where pymupdf's is a fraction of the shorter side; fill=Color(r, g, b) and stroke=Stroke(paint=Color(r, g, b), width=..., cap=..., join=..., dashes=...) replace color, fill, width, lineCap, lineJoin, and dashes, and a Color's alpha the opacities.
- Shape.draw_sector -> PathBuilder.sector: canvas.path(PathBuilder().sector(center, radius, start, sweep, pie=True), fill=..., stroke=...), with angles in degrees clockwise from the x axis.
- Shape.draw_squiggle -> PathBuilder.wave: canvas.path(PathBuilder().wave(p1, p2, breadth=2), stroke=...).
- Shape.draw_zigzag -> PathBuilder.zigzag: canvas.path(PathBuilder().zigzag(p1, p2, breadth=2), stroke=...).
- Shape.finish -> Stroke: Pass fill=Color(...) and stroke=Stroke(paint=Color(...), width=..., cap=..., join=..., dashes=...) to each canvas call; fill_rule=FillRule.EVEN_ODD replaces even_odd, and PathBuilder.close() closes a path.
- Shape.insert_text -> Canvas.text: canvas.text(text, at, font=..., size=..., fill=...) draws lines in call order with the paths, not on top of them; rotate= turns clockwise, where pymupdf turns anticlockwise.
- Shape.insert_textbox -> Canvas.textbox: canvas.textbox(rect, text, font=..., size=..., align=...) returns a TextFit; Font.text_height measures the height the text needs, and rotate= turns clockwise, where pymupdf turns anticlockwise.
- Shape.last_point -> PathBuilder.current_point: PathBuilder.current_point is the end of the last segment added.
- SigFlag_* -> SignatureFlags: SignatureFlags.SIGNATURES_EXIST and SignatureFlags.APPEND_ONLY are the bits of doc.form.signature_flags.
- TEXT_ACCURATE_ASCENDERS -> Page.layout: Pass exact_bboxes=True to words(), layout(), or search() to box each glyph by its outline instead of the font's ascender and descender.
- TEXT_ACCURATE_BBOXES -> Page.layout: Pass exact_bboxes=True to words(), layout(), or search() to box each glyph by its outline.
- TEXT_ACCURATE_SIDE_BEARINGS -> Page.layout: Pass exact_bboxes=True to words(), layout(), or search() to box each glyph by its outline, side bearings excluded.
- TEXT_ALIGN_CENTER -> Canvas.textbox: canvas.textbox(rect, text, align="center") takes the alignment as a string.
- TEXT_ALIGN_JUSTIFY -> Canvas.textbox: canvas.textbox(rect, text, align="justify") takes the alignment as a string.
- TEXT_ALIGN_LEFT -> Canvas.textbox: canvas.textbox(rect, text, align="left") takes the alignment as a string.
- TEXT_ALIGN_RIGHT -> Canvas.textbox: canvas.textbox(rect, text, align="right") takes the alignment as a string.
- TEXT_CLIP -> Page.text: Glyphs that the page or the clip paths hide entirely are left out by default; pass clipped=True to text(), words(), layout(), or search() to keep them, flagged by Span.is_clipped.
- TEXT_CLIP_RECT -> Page.text: Pass clip=rect to text(), words(), layout(), or search(); it keeps the glyphs whose box's center lies inside the rectangle.
- TEXT_COLLECT_STYLES -> Page.layout: Pass styles=True to page.layout(); Span.is_underlined and Span.is_struck flag text that a horizontal vector rule underlines or strikes out.
- TEXT_COLLECT_VECTORS -> Page.content: Read page.content(text_runs=False, images=False).paths for the vector graphics that pymupdf adds to its text output.
- TEXT_DEHYPHENATE -> Page.text: Pass dehyphenate=True to text(), words(), layout(), or search() to join a word that a hyphen splits at a line end.
- TEXT_FONT_* -> Span: Read span.is_superscript, is_italic, is_serif, is_monospaced, and is_bold of page.layout(); Layout.to_dict() gives them as the bits of pymupdf's flags.
- TEXT_FUZZY_VECTORS -> Page.content: Read page.content(text_runs=False, images=False).paths for the vector graphics that pymupdf adds to its text output.
- TEXT_LAZY_VECTORS -> Page.content: Read page.content(text_runs=False, images=False).paths for the vector graphics that pymupdf adds to its text output.
- TEXT_MEDIABOX_CLIP -> Page.text: Glyphs that the page or the clip paths hide entirely are left out by default; pass clipped=True to text(), words(), layout(), or search() to keep them, flagged by Span.is_clipped.
- TEXT_PRESERVE_IMAGES -> Page.content: Read page.content(text_runs=False, paths=False).images for the images that pymupdf adds to its text output.
- TEXT_PRESERVE_LIGATURES -> Page.text: Ligature characters are kept by default; pass ligatures=False to text(), words(), layout(), or search() to expand them to their letters.
- TEXT_PRESERVE_WHITESPACE -> Page.text: Whitespace characters are kept by default; pass whitespace=False to text(), words(), layout(), or search() to make each one a space.
- TEXT_USE_GID_FOR_UNKNOWN_UNICODE -> Unmapped: Pass unmapped="glyph_id" to text(), words(), layout(), or search(); unmapped="replacement" gives U+FFFD instead.
- TextPage.extractBLOCKS -> Page.layout: Read page.layout().blocks, Block records with text, bbox, and lines.
- TextPage.extractDICT -> Layout.to_dict: Call page.layout().to_dict(), which returns the dictionary shape of pymupdf's "dict" output.
- TextPage.extractHTML -> Layout.to_html: Call page.layout().to_html(), a positioned HTML fragment with one paragraph per line.
- TextPage.extractIMGINFO -> Page.content: Read page.content(text_runs=False, paths=False).images, the Image records of the page's drawn images.
- TextPage.extractJSON -> Layout.to_dict: Write json.dumps(page.layout().to_dict()); the dictionary has the shape of pymupdf's "json" output.
- TextPage.extractRAWDICT -> Layout.to_dict: Call page.layout(chars=True).to_dict(), which returns the dictionary shape of pymupdf's "rawdict" output.
- TextPage.extractRAWJSON -> Layout.to_dict: Write json.dumps(page.layout(chars=True).to_dict()); the dictionary has the shape of pymupdf's "rawjson" output.
- TextPage.extractSelection -> Page.selection: Call page.selection(start, end), which returns the text in reading order from the character nearest start to the one nearest end.
- TextPage.extractTEXT -> Page.text: Call page.text().
- TextPage.extractText -> Page.text: Call page.text().
- TextPage.extractTextbox -> Page.text: Call page.text(clip=rect), which keeps the glyphs whose box's center lies inside the rectangle, in reading order.
- TextPage.extractWORDS -> Page.words: Call page.words(), which returns Word records with text, bbox, block, line, and index.
- TextPage.extractXHTML -> Page.markdown: Call page.markdown(), which gives the page's headings, paragraphs, lists, and tables in semantic form.
- TextPage.extractXML -> Layout.to_xml: Call page.layout(chars=True).to_xml(), which lists blocks, lines, fonts, and characters.
- TextPage.rect -> Page.rect: Read page.rect.
- TextPage.search -> Page.search: Call page.search(text), which returns one Rect per match, or one Quad per line of a match with quads=True.
- Widget.border_color -> Widget.border_color: widget.border_color is a Color or None, assignable and deletable.
- Widget.border_dashes -> Widget.border: widget.border.dashes; assign widget.border = Border(width, dashes=...).
- Widget.border_style -> Widget.border: widget.border.style is a BorderStyle member.
- Widget.border_width -> Widget.border: widget.border.width; assign widget.border = Border(width).
- Widget.button_caption -> Widget.caption: widget.caption is a pushbutton's caption, assignable and deletable.
- Widget.button_states -> Widget.button_states: widget.button_states is the tuple of normal-appearance state names, such as ('Yes', 'Off').
- Widget.choice_values -> Field.choices: Read doc.form[name].choices, FieldChoice records with value and label.
- Widget.field_display -> Widget.flags: widget.flags holds AnnotationFlags.HIDDEN, PRINT, and NO_VIEW, which pymupdf's field_display summarizes.
- Widget.field_flags -> Field.flags: Read doc.form[name].flags, a FieldFlags value.
- Widget.field_label -> Field.label: widget.field.label is the field's /TU description, assignable and deletable.
- Widget.field_name -> Field.name: Read doc.form[name].name, or iterate over the keys of doc.form.
- Widget.field_type -> Field.type: Read doc.form[name].type, a FieldType member.
- Widget.field_type_string -> Field.type: Read doc.form[name].type, a FieldType member whose value is a lowercase name such as text.
- Widget.field_value -> Field.value: Read or assign doc.form[name].value; assignment regenerates the appearances at once, so no update() follows.
- Widget.fill_color -> Widget.background_color: widget.background_color is the /MK /BG Color or None, assignable and deletable.
- Widget.is_signed -> Field.is_signed: widget.field.is_signed is True for a signature field whose /V is a signature dictionary, and False otherwise, where pymupdf returns None for other fields.
- Widget.next -> Widgets: Iterate page.widgets.
- Widget.on_state -> Widget.on_state: widget.on_state is the state that selects a check box or radio button.
- Widget.rb_parent -> Widget.field: widget.field is the radio group's Field.
- Widget.reset -> Field.reset: widget.field.reset() restores the field's default_value, or clears it, and draws its widgets again.
- Widget.script -> Widget.scripts: widget.scripts[ScriptTrigger.ACTIVATE] = js sets the JavaScript action the widget runs when activated (/A).
- Widget.script_blur -> Widget.scripts: widget.scripts[ScriptTrigger.BLUR] = js sets the script run when the widget loses focus.
- Widget.script_calc -> Field.scripts: widget.field.scripts[ScriptTrigger.CALCULATE] = js sets the calculation script and lists the field in /CO.
- Widget.script_change -> Field.scripts: widget.field.scripts[ScriptTrigger.VALIDATE] = js sets the script run when the value changes.
- Widget.script_focus -> Widget.scripts: widget.scripts[ScriptTrigger.FOCUS] = js sets the script run when the widget receives focus.
- Widget.script_format -> Field.scripts: widget.field.scripts[ScriptTrigger.FORMAT] = js sets the formatting script.
- Widget.script_stroke -> Field.scripts: widget.field.scripts[ScriptTrigger.KEYSTROKE] = js sets the keystroke script.
- Widget.text_font -> Widget.font: widget.font is the Standard 14 Font that /DA names, assignable with Font.standard(...).
- Widget.text_fontsize -> Widget.font_size: widget.font_size is the /DA size, 0 to fit the text; assignable.
- Widget.text_format -> Field.scripts: Number, date, time, and percent formats are Acrobat scripts: set field.scripts[ScriptTrigger.FORMAT] and [ScriptTrigger.KEYSTROKE], for example to 'AFNumber_Format(2, 0, 0, 0, "", true);'.
- Widget.text_maxlen -> Field.max_length: widget.field.max_length is the text field's /MaxLen, assignable and deletable.
- Widget.update -> Widget: Assign widget properties; each assignment draws the widget again, so there is no update().
- csGRAY -> Colorspace: Use pylopdf.Colorspace.GRAY.
- csRGB -> Colorspace: Use pylopdf.Colorspace.RGB.
- get_pdf_now -> pdf_date: Use pylopdf.pdf_date(), or pdf_date(value) for a given datetime; parse_pdf_date(text) reads one back.
- get_pdf_str -> String: Write a Python str into the object model, which encodes it as a PDF text string, or read String.text.
- get_text_length -> Font.text_width: Font.standard("Helvetica").text_width(text, size) measures Standard 14 text; an OpenType face measures with its own Font.text_width.
- glyph_name_to_unicode -> glyph_text: pylopdf.glyph_text(name) returns the text that a glyph name stands for, "" for none, where pymupdf returns one code point.
- image_profile -> image_info: Call pylopdf.image_info(source), which takes a path or encoded bytes and returns an ImageInfo record: format ('jpeg', 'png', or 'jpx'), width, height, components, alpha, bits, resolution as (xres, yres), and orientation; canvas.image applies the orientation itself, so no transform is needed.
- linkDest -> Destination: link.target holds a URI string, Destination(page, point, zoom), RemoteDestination(file, page), Launch(file), or NamedAction(name).
- paper_* -> PaperSize: Use PaperSize members, such as PaperSize.A4 for paper_size("a4") and PaperSize.A4.landscape for "a4-l"; a member is a (width, height) pair that doc.pages.new takes, and Rect(0, 0, *PaperSize.A4) replaces paper_rect.
- planish_line -> Matrix.planish: Matrix.planish(p1, p2) returns the same matrix.
- recover_* -> Span: Read span.quad and line.quad of page.layout(): each follows the baseline of rotated text, so no quad needs recovering from a box; page.search(text, quads=True) gives the quad of any run of characters.
- sRGB_to_* -> Color: Span colors are Color values with red, green, and blue from 0 to 1, which sRGB_to_pdf returned; layout().to_dict() keeps pymupdf's sRGB integer c, which (c >> 16 & 255, c >> 8 & 255, c & 255) splits as sRGB_to_rgb did.
- set_log -> PylopdfWarning: Filter or record pylopdf's diagnostics as PylopdfWarning with the warnings module.
- set_messages -> PylopdfWarning: Filter or record pylopdf's diagnostics as PylopdfWarning with the warnings module.
- unicode_to_glyph_name -> glyph_name: pylopdf.glyph_name(char) takes the character and returns its Adobe Glyph List name, or uniXXXX for a character the list does not name.

- Document.get_pdfa_claim -> Document.pdfa_claim: doc.pdfa_claim returns a PdfaClaim record with part and conformance, or None, instead of a tuple.
- Document.get_text -> Document.text: Call doc.text(pages).

- Document.render_page_svg -> Page.svg: Use doc.pages[i].svg().

- LinkInfo.to -> Link.target: link.target is a URI string, Destination, RemoteDestination, Launch, or NamedAction; read its fields.
- LinkInfo.uri -> Link.target: link.target is a URI string, Destination, RemoteDestination, Launch, or NamedAction; read its fields.
- LinkInfo.zoom -> Link.target: link.target is a URI string, Destination, RemoteDestination, Launch, or NamedAction; read its fields.
- MetadataProbe -> Probe: probe(source) returns a Probe record.
- MetadataProbe.author -> Probe.metadata: Read probe.metadata["author"].
- MetadataProbe.creationDate -> Probe.metadata: Read probe.metadata["created"].
- MetadataProbe.creator -> Probe.metadata: Read probe.metadata["creator"].
- MetadataProbe.encrypted -> Probe.needs_password: Read probe.needs_password.
- MetadataProbe.format -> Probe.version: Read probe.version, such as "1.7".
- MetadataProbe.keywords -> Probe.metadata: Read probe.metadata["keywords"].
- MetadataProbe.modDate -> Probe.metadata: Read probe.metadata["modified"].
- MetadataProbe.page_count -> Probe.page_count: Read probe.page_count.
- MetadataProbe.producer -> Probe.metadata: Read probe.metadata["producer"].
- MetadataProbe.repaired -> Probe.is_repaired: Read probe.is_repaired.
- MetadataProbe.subject -> Probe.metadata: Read probe.metadata["subject"].
- MetadataProbe.title -> Probe.metadata: Read probe.metadata["title"].
- MetadataUpdate -> Metadata.update: Pass the values to doc.metadata.update(); del doc.metadata[key] removes an entry.
- MetadataUpdate.author -> Metadata.update: Pass author to doc.metadata.update().
- MetadataUpdate.creationDate -> Metadata.update: Pass created to doc.metadata.update().
- MetadataUpdate.creator -> Metadata.update: Pass creator to doc.metadata.update().
- MetadataUpdate.keywords -> Metadata.update: Pass keywords to doc.metadata.update().
- MetadataUpdate.modDate -> Metadata.update: Pass modified to doc.metadata.update().
- MetadataUpdate.producer -> Metadata.update: Pass producer to doc.metadata.update().
- MetadataUpdate.subject -> Metadata.update: Pass subject to doc.metadata.update().
- MetadataUpdate.title -> Metadata.update: Pass title to doc.metadata.update().
- Page.add_link_annot -> Links.add: Use page.links.add(rect, uri).
- Page.get_text_ocr -> Page.ocr: Call page.ocr(...), which returns OcrWord records with text, bbox, and confidence.
- Page.insert_ocr_text_layer -> Page.apply_ocr: Call page.apply_ocr(words=[OcrWord(text=..., bbox=..., confidence=...), ...], skip_existing=False).
- Page.render -> Page.pixmap: Use page.pixmap(dpi=72 * scale, alpha=True).to_bytes() for the PNG.
- Page.render_svg -> Page.svg: Use page.svg().
- Page.to_markdown -> Page.markdown: Call page.markdown(...).
- PageLabelInfo -> PageLabelRange: doc.page_labels returns PageLabelRange records instead of PageLabelInfo dictionaries.
- PageLabelInfo.firstpagenum -> PageLabelRange.first: Read label_range.first.
- PageLabelInfo.prefix -> PageLabelRange.prefix: Read label_range.prefix.
- PageLabelInfo.startpage -> PageLabelRange.start: Read label_range.start.
- PageLabelInfo.style -> PageLabelRange.style: Read label_range.style, a PageLabelStyle member or None.
- PageLabelSpec -> PageLabelRange: Assign PageLabelRange(start, style, prefix, first) records to doc.page_labels.
- PageLabelSpec.firstpagenum -> PageLabelRange.first: Pass first= to PageLabelRange.
- PageLabelSpec.prefix -> PageLabelRange.prefix: Pass prefix= to PageLabelRange.
- PageLabelSpec.startpage -> PageLabelRange.start: Pass start to PageLabelRange.
- PageLabelSpec.style -> PageLabelRange.style: Pass style= to PageLabelRange: a PageLabelStyle member, its value, or None.
- Permissions.COPY_FOR_ACCESSIBILITY -> Permissions.ACCESSIBILITY: Use Permissions.ACCESSIBILITY.
- Permissions.FILL_FORMS -> Permissions.FORM: Use Permissions.FORM.
- Permissions.PRINT_HIGH_QUALITY -> Permissions.PRINT_HQ: Use Permissions.PRINT_HQ.
- RawTextBlock -> Block: page.layout().blocks holds Block records.
- RawTextBlock.bbox -> Block.bbox: Read block.bbox.
- RawTextBlock.lines -> Block.lines: Read block.lines.
- RawTextBlock.number -> Layout.blocks: A block's number is its index in layout.blocks.
- RawTextBlock.type -> Block: Every block of a Layout holds text.
- RawTextLine -> Line: block.lines holds Line records.
- RawTextLine.bbox -> Line.bbox: Read line.bbox.
- RawTextLine.dir -> Line.direction: Read line.direction.
- RawTextLine.spans -> Line.spans: Read line.spans.
- RawTextLine.wmode -> Line.is_vertical: Read line.is_vertical.
- RawTextPage -> Layout: page.layout(chars=True) returns a Layout whose spans hold Char records.
- RawTextPage.blocks -> Layout.blocks: Read layout.blocks.
- RawTextPage.height -> Layout.height: Read layout.height.
- RawTextPage.width -> Layout.width: Read layout.width.
- RawTextSpan -> Span: line.spans holds Span records.
- RawTextSpan.bbox -> Span.bbox: Read span.bbox.
- RawTextSpan.chars -> Span.chars: Call page.layout(chars=True) and read span.chars.
- RawTextSpan.flags -> Span.is_bold: Read span.is_bold, is_italic, is_serif, and is_monospaced.
- RawTextSpan.font -> Span.font: Read span.font.
- RawTextSpan.origin -> Span.origin: Read span.origin.
- RawTextSpan.size -> Span.size: Read span.size.
- Shape.__enter__ -> Canvas: Use with page.draw() as canvas:, which writes the drawing when the block ends.
- Shape.__exit__ -> Canvas: Use with page.draw() as canvas:, which writes the drawing when the block ends.
- Table.col_count -> Table.rows: Use len(table.rows[0]).
- Table.confidence -> TableDiagnostics.confidence: Read table.diagnostics.confidence.
- Table.extract -> Table.rows: Read table.rows, the cell text row by row.
- Table.page -> Page.tables: Keep the page whose tables() returned the table.
- Table.row_count -> Table.rows: Use len(table.rows).
- Table.strategy -> TableDiagnostics.strategy: Read table.diagnostics.strategy.
- Table.to_markdown -> Table.markdown: Call table.markdown(...).
- TableFinder -> Page.tables: page.tables() returns a list of Table records.
- TableFinder.__getitem__ -> Page.tables: Index the list that page.tables() returns.
- TableFinder.__iter__ -> Page.tables: Iterate over the list that page.tables() returns.
- TableFinder.__len__ -> Page.tables: Take len() of the list that page.tables() returns.
- TableFinder.cells -> Table.cells: Read the cells of each table that page.tables() returns.
- TableFinder.clip -> Page.tables: page.tables(clip=...) returns only the tables inside the clip; keep the clip you passed.
- TableFinder.page -> Page.tables: Keep the page whose tables() you called.
- TableFinder.strategy -> TableDiagnostics.strategy: Read table.diagnostics.strategy of each table.
- TableFinder.tables -> Page.tables: page.tables() returns the list itself.
- TextBlock -> Block: page.layout().blocks holds Block records.
- TextBlock.bbox -> Block.bbox: Read block.bbox.
- TextBlock.lines -> Block.lines: Read block.lines.
- TextBlock.number -> Layout.blocks: A block's number is its index in layout.blocks.
- TextBlock.type -> Block: Every block of a Layout holds text.
- TextChar -> Char: page.layout(chars=True) gives every span Char records.
- TextChar.bbox -> Char.bbox: Read char.bbox.
- TextChar.c -> Char.text: Read char.text.
- TextChar.origin -> Char.origin: Read char.origin.
- TextLine -> Line: block.lines holds Line records.
- TextLine.bbox -> Line.bbox: Read line.bbox.
- TextLine.dir -> Line.direction: Read line.direction.
- TextLine.spans -> Line.spans: Read line.spans.
- TextLine.wmode -> Line.is_vertical: Read line.is_vertical.
- TextPage -> Layout: page.layout() returns a Layout record; layout.to_dict() returns the dictionary.
- TextPage.blocks -> Layout.blocks: Read layout.blocks.
- TextPage.height -> Layout.height: Read layout.height.
- TextPage.width -> Layout.width: Read layout.width.
- TextSpan -> Span: line.spans holds Span records.
- TextSpan.bbox -> Span.bbox: Read span.bbox.
- TextSpan.flags -> Span.is_bold: Read span.is_bold, is_italic, is_serif, and is_monospaced.
- TextSpan.font -> Span.font: Read span.font.
- TextSpan.origin -> Span.origin: Read span.origin.
- TextSpan.size -> Span.size: Read span.size.
- TextSpan.text -> Span.text: Read span.text.
- WordEntry -> Word: page.words() returns Word records with text, bbox, block, line, and index.
- peek_metadata -> probe: probe(source) takes a path or bytes and returns a Probe record with page_count, version, needs_password, is_repaired, and metadata.
